description: A vulnerability has been found in SourceCodester Online Faculty Clearance System 1.0. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /delete_requirement.php. The manipulation of the argument ID leads to sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.
